findings.summary: ResizeObserver re-scroll can hijack scroll: it fires whenever the deep-link section first gets a box, with no check that the user has not scrolled or that location.hash still equals the captured slug (user can click another category or scroll during slow Suspense streaming and be yanked back). Fix: in the callback bail out unless fromHash() === slug and no wheel/touch/keydown/scroll input occurred since mount, and add a ~2s safety disconnect

Allow-list prefixes /api/ and /auth/ are open-ended: any future API route or page added under them is reachable by non-admins pre-launch. Fine today (only /api/event-config exists); narrow to /api/event-config and /auth/callback or add a unit test that enumerates routes under src/app/api

Matcher regex is not tested against the allow-list assumptions, and the pre-launch gate has no e2e (webServer pins a past date); only unit tests with mocked session cover it. Add a matcher test over sample paths and one pre-launch e2e project with a future EVENT_START_AT

Fail-open is per spec (BR-003) but means a production deploy that forgets EVENT_START_AT silently opens the whole site pre-launch; add a one-time server log warning when the var is set but invalid, and document the required env in the deploy checklist

Retry interval repeats router.replace every 5s indefinitely if the proxy keeps bouncing (clock skew or env mismatch); bounded in rate, not in count. Cap at a handful of retries or stop once the tab is hidden
Breaking env rename (NEXT_PUBLIC_EVENT_START_AT removed): deployments without server-side EVENT_START_AT silently fail open; call out in changelog and deploy notes
